gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of GPC3-positive recurrent glioblastoma with previous resection

candidate_evidence.quote: GPC3-CAR and IL15 will be administered to patients with GPC3-positive glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of GPC3-positive recurrent glioblastoma with previous resection

role_evidence.quote: This study will test T cells genetically engineered with a GPC3-CAR and IL15 (GO-CART T cells) in participants with GPC3-positive brain tumors.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous GPC3-directed CAR T cells co-expressing IL15 and iCasp9 safety switch, intracavitary/intraventricular

source_quote.quote: Diagnosis of GPC3-positive recurrent glioblastoma with previous resection planned for repeat resection (as determined by immunohistochemistry).

coder_notes: Only intervention is a CAR T-cell product (excluded type). Acetaminophen and diphenhydramine premedication are optional ('may be pretreated') and AP1903 is used only if needed to eliminate T cells; none are registered interventions given to every patient, so not listed (R9). GPC3 eligibility is not candidate-matched because the GPC3-directed agent is a cell therapy. Tumour/CSF sampling for CAR T-cell detection relates to the cell product, not a candidate.
